signals.name: Apple Inc
signals.thesis: Apple breaking to new ATH ($294.80) on iPhone 17 pre-cycle momentum and Services revenue acceleration. AI integration via Apple Intelligence driving upgrade cycle expectations. Price 4.7% above 50-DMA with sustained volume. CPI Tuesday is the key risk — benign print = green light for mega-cap tech continuation.

signals.name: UnitedHealth Group
signals.thesis: UnitedHealth near ATH ($396.39) as managed care benefits from Medicare Advantage enrollment growth and Optum Health margin expansion. Defensive quality name that outperforms in both risk-on and risk-off. 8.5% above 50-DMA with BUY signal active. CPI-resilient — healthcare spending is non-discretionary.

signals.name: VanEck Semiconductor ETF
signals.thesis: SMH semiconductor ETF at ATH ($561.25) capturing broadest semi rally since AI cycle began. Top holdings NVDA, AVGO, AMD all at or near highs. Diversified exposure reduces single-stock risk vs holding individual semis. Memory cycle inflection (MU, SK Hynix) + foundry renaissance (INTC, TSM) driving sector-wide momentum.

signals.name: Fortinet Inc
signals.thesis: Fortinet sustaining ATH breakout ($113.87) as cybersecurity spending remains non-discretionary across enterprises. FortiAI platform driving ARPU expansion. Firewall refresh cycle re-accelerating billings growth. Repeat pick from 20260512 scan — momentum confirmed with continued institutional accumulation.

signals.name: Schlumberger NV
signals.thesis: SLB momentum play as oil surges +4.27% to $102.26 on Middle East supply concerns. Leading oilfield services company benefits directly from upstream capex acceleration. International revenue diversification (80% non-US) provides DXY weakness tailwind. BUY signal active, price above all DMAs.

signals.name: The Goldman Sachs Group
signals.thesis: Goldman Sachs at ATH ($945.90) on investment banking recovery and FICC trading revenue surge. M&A advisory pipeline strongest since 2021. Capital markets reopening driving IPO and debt issuance fees. Forward PE attractive at ~13x for best-in-class ROE. Financials sector rotation intact.

signals.name: TotalEnergies SE
signals.thesis: TotalEnergies momentum sustained near ATH ($91.76) with oil at $102+ providing direct earnings tailwind. Integrated energy model with growing LNG and renewables portfolio. 4%+ dividend yield. EU energy security premium post-Russia decoupling. Repeat pick — trend confirmed with DXY weakness amplifying EUR-denominated returns.

signals.name: Costco Wholesale
signals.thesis: Costco at ATH ($1021.88) as membership model proves recession-proof. Same-store sales growth accelerating on value-seeking consumer behavior. E-commerce penetration rising. Defensive growth name that outperforms regardless of CPI outcome — inflation drives more consumers to warehouse clubs.

signals.name: Novo Nordisk A/S

Significant valuation discount to LLY creates relative value opportunity. CagriSema next-gen obesity data imminent. Repeat pick — entry zone holding above support.

signals.name: iShares MSCI Taiwan ETF
